name: Bamyan Valley
description: Bamyan Valley is renowned for its dramatic sandstone cliffs, ancient cave complexes, and rich Buddhist heritage. Although the famous giant Buddha statues were destroyed, the valley remains one of Afghanistan's most important historical and scenic destinations.

name: Band-e-Amir National Park
description: Afghanistan's first national park, Band-e-Amir is famous for six deep-blue lakes separated by natural travertine dams. The striking contrast between turquoise water and rugged mountains makes it the country's premier natural attraction.

name: Gardens of Babur
description: Built in the 16th century by Emperor Babur, these terraced gardens offer peaceful landscapes, historical architecture, and panoramic views over Kabul. It is one of the city's most significant cultural landmarks.

name: Darul Aman Palace
description: Darul Aman Palace is a restored early-20th-century royal palace symbolising Afghanistan's modern history. Its grand European-inspired architecture attracts visitors interested in history and heritage.

name: Herat Citadel
description: Also known as the Citadel of Alexander, this ancient fortress has stood for centuries overlooking Herat. It showcases Persian, Timurid, and Islamic architectural influences.

name: Friday Mosque (Jami Mosque)
description: One of Central Asia's finest mosques, the Friday Mosque is celebrated for its intricate blue-tiled façades, elegant courtyards, and centuries of Islamic architecture.

name: Wakhan Corridor
description: The Wakhan Corridor is a remote mountain region bordered by the Pamirs and the Hindu Kush. Visitors experience pristine alpine scenery, glaciers, traditional villages, and exceptional trekking routes.

name: Noshaq Peak
description: Noshaq is Afghanistan's highest mountain at over 7,400 metres. It attracts experienced climbers seeking challenging expeditions in the Hindu Kush range.

name: Salang Pass
description: Salang Pass connects northern and southern Afghanistan through spectacular mountain landscapes. The route offers breathtaking alpine scenery and engineering landmarks.

name: Ancient City of Balkh
description: Often called the "Mother of Cities," Balkh has been an important centre of civilisation for over 2,000 years. Ancient ruins, mosques, and fortifications reflect its rich cultural legacy.

name: Berat Old Town (Mangalem & Gorica)
description: Known as the “City of a Thousand Windows,” Berat is famous for Ottoman-era houses, stone streets, and hillside neighbourhoods. The town reflects centuries of coexistence between different cultures and religions.

name: Berat Castle (Kalaja e Beratit)
description: This ancient hilltop fortress dates back to antiquity and contains churches, historic houses, and viewpoints overlooking the Osum River valley. It remains one of Albania’s best-preserved castles.

name: Gjirokastër Old Town
description: Gjirokastër is a UNESCO-listed stone city known for its Ottoman houses, cobbled streets, and dramatic mountain setting. It is one of Albania’s most atmospheric heritage destinations.

name: Gjirokastër Castle
description: One of the largest castles in the Balkans, this fortress offers panoramic views over the Drino Valley. It contains museums, old military structures, and cultural exhibits.

name: Ksamil Islands
description: Ksamil is famous for turquoise waters, small islands, white beaches, and Mediterranean scenery. It is considered one of Albania’s most beautiful coastal destinations.

name: Blue Eye (Syri i Kaltër)
description: The Blue Eye is a deep natural spring with incredibly clear blue water surrounded by lush vegetation. Its unusual colour and mysterious depth make it one of Albania’s most visited natural attractions.

name: Albanian Riviera
description: The Albanian Riviera stretches along the Ionian Sea with dramatic mountains, hidden beaches, and charming coastal villages. Popular stops include Himarë, Dhërmi, and Borsh.

name: Lake Shkodër
description: Lake Shkodër is the largest lake in Southern Europe and is surrounded by mountains, wetlands, and fishing villages. It is ideal for boating, birdwatching, and nature exploration.

name: Rozafa Castle
description: Rozafa Castle sits on a rocky hill overlooking Shkodër and the meeting point of three rivers. The fortress offers spectacular views and carries centuries of legends and history.

name: Valbona Valley National Park
description: Located in the Albanian Alps, Valbona Valley features dramatic peaks, forests, rivers, and hiking trails. It is one of the country's top destinations for mountain adventures.

name: Theth National Park
description: Theth is a remote alpine village surrounded by rugged peaks and traditional stone houses. Highlights include hiking trails, waterfalls, and the famous Blue Eye of Theth.

name: Dardha Village
description: Dardha is a scenic mountain village known for forests, traditional architecture, and winter activities. It is a popular getaway for nature lovers.

name: Lake Ohrid
description: Lake Ohrid is one of Europe’s oldest and deepest lakes, shared with North Macedonia. Its clear waters, biodiversity, and lakeside towns make it a major attraction.

name: Durrës Amphitheatre
description: Built during the Roman period, the Durrës Amphitheatre is one of the largest ancient arenas in the Balkans. It provides insight into Albania’s Roman heritage.

name: Dajti Mountain National Park
description: Dajti Mountain rises above Tirana and offers forests, cable car rides, hiking trails, and panoramic city views. It is the capital’s most popular natural escape.

name: Skanderbeg Square
description: The central square of Tirana is surrounded by important landmarks including museums, government buildings, and cultural sites. It represents Albania’s national identity and history.

name: Casbah of Algiers
description: The Casbah is a historic Mediterranean hillside district with narrow streets, Ottoman-era houses, mosques, and traditional markets. It represents centuries of Algerian and Ottoman heritage.

name: Notre Dame d'Afrique
description: This 19th-century basilica overlooks the Mediterranean Sea from a hilltop location. It is admired for its architecture, religious significance, and panoramic views of Algiers.

name: Jardin d'Essai du Hamma
description: One of Africa’s finest botanical gardens, featuring rare plants, palm-lined paths, and landscaped gardens. It provides a peaceful green escape in the capital city.

name: Tlemcen National Park
description: This park protects forests, limestone landscapes, and mountain ecosystems near Tlemcen. Visitors enjoy hiking, caves, and scenic viewpoints.

name: Mansourah Ruins
description: The ruins of Mansourah include remnants of a medieval city built during the Marinid period. The famous minaret reflects the region’s Islamic architectural heritage.

name: Timgad Roman Ruins
description: Timgad is one of the best-preserved Roman cities in North Africa. Its grid layout, theatre, temples, and arches showcase the grandeur of Roman urban planning.

name: Djémila Roman Ruins
description: Djémila is an ancient Roman mountain settlement known for temples, forums, basilicas, and beautifully preserved stone structures. It combines history with spectacular mountain scenery.

name: Constantine City & Bridges
description: Known as the “City of Bridges,” Constantine sits above a dramatic canyon crossed by spectacular suspension bridges. Its location and architecture make it one of Algeria’s most scenic cities.

name: Palace of Ahmed Bey
description: This historic palace features elaborate decorations, courtyards, and artwork reflecting Ottoman and Algerian traditions. It is one of Constantine’s major cultural attractions.

name: Jijel Coast
description: Jijel is known for Mediterranean beaches, rocky cliffs, forests, and clear waters. It offers a quieter coastal experience with beautiful natural landscapes.

name: Gouraya National Park
description: Gouraya National Park combines mountains, forests, beaches, and coastal cliffs. It is famous for wildlife, hiking trails, and views over the Mediterranean.

name: Cap Carbon
description: Cap Carbon features one of the world’s highest natural sea cliffs with a historic lighthouse. The site provides breathtaking views of the Mediterranean coastline.

name: Ahaggar National Park
description: The Ahaggar Mountains are a vast desert wilderness featuring volcanic peaks, ancient rock formations, and Tuareg cultural heritage. It is one of the Sahara’s most spectacular landscapes.

name: Tassili n'Ajjer National Park
description: Tassili n’Ajjer is famous for surreal sandstone formations and thousands of prehistoric rock paintings. It is one of the world’s most important archaeological landscapes.

name: M'zab Valley
description: The M’zab Valley is a UNESCO-listed desert region known for its unique fortified towns, traditional architecture, and preserved Berber culture.

name: Timimoun Oasis
description: Timimoun is a beautiful Sahara oasis famous for red clay architecture, palm groves, and traditional desert landscapes.

name: Fort Santa Cruz
description: Built on a hill overlooking Oran Bay, Fort Santa Cruz offers historic architecture and sweeping views of the Mediterranean coastline.

name: El Oued Sand Dunes
description: Known as the “City of a Thousand Domes,” El Oued is surrounded by golden Sahara dunes and traditional desert architecture.

name: Grandvalira Ski Resort
description: Grandvalira is one of the largest ski areas in the Pyrenees, offering excellent slopes, snow activities, and mountain scenery. In summer, the region becomes popular for hiking and outdoor adventures.

name: Sanctuary of Meritxell
description: The Sanctuary of Meritxell is Andorra’s most important religious monument dedicated to its patron saint. Its modern architecture blends spiritual significance with dramatic mountain surroundings.

name: Lake Engolasters
description: Lake Engolasters is a picturesque mountain lake surrounded by forests and hiking trails. It is one of the easiest natural escapes from Andorra la Vella.

name: Madriu-Perafita-Claror Valley
description: This UNESCO-listed valley preserves a unique cultural landscape shaped by centuries of farming and mountain life. It features forests, rivers, stone paths, and traditional shelters.

name: Vallnord – Pal Arinsal
description: Vallnord offers skiing in winter and mountain biking, hiking, and adventure sports during warmer months. The area provides spectacular views of the Pyrenees.

name: Comapedrosa Valley
description: The Comapedrosa Valley contains Andorra’s highest peak, Comapedrosa Peak, surrounded by alpine lakes, forests, and scenic hiking routes.

name: Ordino Village
description: Ordino is a charming mountain village known for stone houses, traditional streets, museums, and preserved Pyrenean culture. It is considered one of Andorra’s most beautiful settlements.

name: Sorteny Valley Natural Park
description: Sorteny Valley is famous for its rich alpine biodiversity, wildflowers, forests, and hiking trails. It is one of the best places in Andorra for nature lovers.

name: Caldea Spa
description: Caldea is a famous thermal spa complex featuring warm mineral waters, pools, and relaxation facilities. It combines wellness experiences with mountain views.

name: Casa de la Vall
description: Casa de la Vall is a historic parliamentary building dating from the 16th century. It represents Andorra’s political heritage and traditional architecture.

name: Church of Sant Esteve
description: This medieval church features Romanesque architecture and historic artwork. It is located in the old quarter of Andorra’s capital city.

name: Naturland
description: Naturland is an outdoor adventure park offering hiking, nature experiences, zip lines, and mountain activities in a forest environment.

name: Tobotronc Alpine Coaster
description: Tobotronc is one of the world’s longest alpine mountain coasters, passing through forest landscapes with views of the Pyrenees.

name: Fortaleza de São Miguel
description: Built by the Portuguese in the 16th century, this historic fortress overlooks Luanda Bay. It now houses the Museum of Military History and offers excellent views of the city and coastline.

name: Ilha do Cabo
description: Ilha do Cabo is a popular coastal area near Luanda known for beaches, seafood restaurants, nightlife, and views of the Atlantic Ocean. It is one of Angola’s best-known seaside destinations.

name: Miradouro da Lua (Moon Viewpoint)
description: Miradouro da Lua features dramatic orange cliffs shaped by wind and erosion along the Atlantic coast. Its unusual landscape resembles a lunar surface and is a favourite photography location.

name: Kissama National Park (Quiçama)
description: Kissama is Angola’s most famous wildlife park, located near the Atlantic coast. It protects elephants, giraffes, antelopes, and many bird species in a restored savanna ecosystem.

name: Muxima Sanctuary
description: The Muxima Sanctuary is one of Angola’s most important pilgrimage sites. The historic church and riverside setting make it a significant cultural and spiritual destination.

name: Iona National Park
description: Iona is one of Africa’s largest national parks, featuring vast desert landscapes, mountains, and unique wildlife adapted to harsh environments. It offers extraordinary adventure and safari experiences.

name: Welwitschia Mirabilis Fields
description: These desert areas are home to the ancient Welwitschia plant, one of the world’s most unusual species. The landscape combines rugged desert scenery with rare botanical wonders.

name: Serra da Leba Pass
description: Serra da Leba is one of Angola’s most spectacular mountain roads, famous for its winding curves and dramatic views across the surrounding valleys.

name: Tundavala Gap
description: Tundavala Gap is a breathtaking canyon viewpoint located high above Lubango. It offers panoramic views over cliffs, valleys, and the vast Angolan landscape.

name: Christ the King Statue
description: Inspired by the famous Christ statues of the world, this monument stands above Lubango and provides impressive views of the city and surrounding mountains.

name: Serra da Chela Mountains
description: The Serra da Chela mountain range features dramatic cliffs, plateaus, and scenic landscapes. It is one of Angola’s most beautiful highland regions.

name: Bie Plateau
description: The Bie Plateau is a highland region with forests, rivers, and rural landscapes. It is important for Angola’s geography and offers peaceful nature experiences.

name: Luiana Partial Reserve
description: Located in southeastern Angola, this reserve contains forests, rivers, and wildlife habitats connected to the Kavango-Zambezi ecosystem.

name: Okavango River Region
description: The Angolan section of the Okavango River forms important wetlands and supports diverse ecosystems. It is an emerging destination for nature and wildlife tourism.

name: Historic Centre of M'banza Kongo
description: M’banza-Kongo was the capital of the historic Kingdom of Kongo and contains important archaeological and cultural remains. It represents a major part of Central African history.

name: Maiombe Forest
description: Maiombe Forest is one of Central Africa’s important rainforest areas, featuring rich biodiversity, rivers, and rare plant and animal species.

name: St. John's City
description: St. John's is the capital and main cultural centre of Antigua. It features colourful colonial buildings, markets, churches, museums, and easy access to nearby beaches.

name: Nelson's Dockyard
description: Nelson's Dockyard is a restored 18th-century British naval dockyard and one of the Caribbean's most important heritage sites. It combines maritime history, old stone buildings, restaurants, and scenic harbour views.

name: Shirley Heights Lookout
description: Shirley Heights offers one of the most famous panoramic views in the Caribbean, overlooking English Harbour and the surrounding coastline. It is especially popular during sunset and weekend cultural events.

name: Half Moon Bay
description: Half Moon Bay is a spectacular crescent-shaped beach known for turquoise waters, soft white sand, and natural beauty. It is considered one of Antigua’s finest beaches.

name: Darkwood Beach
description: Darkwood Beach offers calm Caribbean waters, palm-lined shores, and beautiful sunset views. It is ideal for swimming, relaxation, and family visits.

name: Falmouth Harbour
description: Falmouth Harbour is a scenic marina area popular with sailing visitors. It provides views of luxury yachts, restaurants, and access to nearby attractions.

name: Fig Tree Drive
description: Fig Tree Drive crosses Antigua’s lush interior with tropical vegetation, villages, and countryside scenery. It is one of the island’s most enjoyable road trips.

name: Fort James
description: Fort James was built in the 18th century to protect Antigua’s harbour entrance. The ruins provide historical interest and views across the Caribbean Sea.

name: Devil's Bridge
description: Devil’s Bridge is a natural limestone arch shaped by Atlantic waves over thousands of years. The dramatic coastline and crashing waves make it a popular sightseeing location.

name: Barbuda Pink Sand Beach
description: Barbuda is famous for its unique pink-coloured sand beaches created from coral fragments. The island offers peaceful surroundings, clear waters, and a remote tropical experience.

name: Frigate Bird Sanctuary
description: The Frigate Bird Sanctuary is one of the largest colonies of frigate birds in the Western Hemisphere. Visitors can explore the lagoon and observe thousands of seabirds.

name: Codrington Lagoon National Park
description: This protected marine area includes mangroves, coral reefs, and important bird habitats. It is known for biodiversity and eco-tourism activities.

name: Fort Barrington
description: Fort Barrington sits on a peninsula overlooking the harbour and provides historical ruins along with excellent coastal views.

name: Valley Church Beach
description: Valley Church Beach is a quiet tropical beach with clear water and soft sand. It is popular among visitors seeking a peaceful Caribbean atmosphere.

name: Buenos Aires City
description: Argentina’s capital is known for European-style architecture, tango culture, historic neighbourhoods, museums, and vibrant nightlife. Popular areas include La Boca, Recoleta, Palermo, and San Telmo.

name: Recoleta Cemetery
description: Recoleta Cemetery is a world-famous cemetery featuring elaborate mausoleums, sculptures, and the graves of many important Argentine figures, including Eva Perón.

name: Casa Rosada
description: Casa Rosada is Argentina’s iconic pink presidential palace located beside Plaza de Mayo. It is one of the country’s most recognisable historical buildings.

name: Tigre Delta
description: The Tigre Delta is a unique network of rivers and islands where visitors explore waterways by boat. It offers nature, traditional houses, markets, and peaceful landscapes near Buenos Aires.

name: Iguazú Falls
description: Iguazú Falls is one of the world’s largest waterfall systems, consisting of hundreds of cascades surrounded by rainforest. The dramatic Devil’s Throat viewpoint is its most famous attraction.

name: Iguazú National Park
description: This protected rainforest area preserves exceptional biodiversity including tropical plants, birds, and wildlife. Walking trails and boat rides provide close views of the waterfalls and jungle.

name: Perito Moreno Glacier
description: Perito Moreno is one of the world’s most accessible glaciers and a highlight of Patagonia. Visitors can observe massive ice formations breaking into the turquoise waters of Lake Argentino.

name: Mount Fitz Roy
description: Mount Fitz Roy is one of Patagonia’s most iconic peaks, famous for its sharp granite towers and challenging trekking routes. It attracts hikers and photographers from around the world.

name: Los Glaciares National Park
description: This vast Patagonian park contains glaciers, lakes, forests, and dramatic mountain landscapes. It is one of South America’s premier wilderness destinations.

name: Tierra del Fuego National Park
description: Located at the southern tip of Argentina, this park combines forests, lakes, mountains, and Beagle Channel coastline. It is a gateway for Antarctic cruises.

name: Beagle Channel
description: The Beagle Channel offers boat tours featuring islands, sea lions, penguins, and dramatic views of mountains meeting the ocean.

name: Aconcagua Provincial Park
description: Aconcagua is the highest mountain outside Asia and a major destination for mountaineers. The surrounding park features spectacular Andean scenery and hiking routes.

name: Wine Route of Mendoza
description: Mendoza is Argentina’s famous wine region, especially known for Malbec. Visitors can explore vineyards, wineries, and scenic landscapes beneath the Andes.

name: Quebrada de Humahuaca
description: This colourful Andean valley features dramatic rock formations, traditional villages, and ancient cultural routes. The Hill of Seven Colours is one of its most photographed locations.

name: Hill of Seven Colours
description: Cerro de los Siete Colores displays layers of colourful minerals creating a spectacular striped mountain landscape. It is a symbol of northern Argentina’s natural beauty.

name: Salinas Grandes
description: Salinas Grandes is a vast white salt plain located high in the Andes. Its reflective surface creates stunning scenery and unique photography opportunities.

name: Nahuel Huapi National Park
description: One of Argentina’s oldest national parks, Nahuel Huapi features crystal-clear lakes, forests, and Andean peaks. It is popular for hiking, boating, and scenic drives.

name: San Carlos de Bariloche
description: Bariloche is a scenic Patagonian city surrounded by lakes and mountains. It is famous for hiking, skiing, chocolate shops, and the Seven Lakes route.

name: Seven Lakes Route
description: This famous road connects beautiful Patagonian lakes surrounded by forests and mountains. It is one of Argentina’s most spectacular road journeys.

name: Peninsula Valdés
description: Peninsula Valdés is a world-renowned wildlife destination where visitors can see whales, sea lions, penguins, and marine birds along the Atlantic coast.

name: Punta Tombo Penguin Reserve
description: Punta Tombo hosts one of the largest Magellanic penguin colonies in the world. Visitors can walk among thousands of penguins in their natural habitat.

name: Sierras de Córdoba
description: The Sierras de Córdoba offer forests, rivers, waterfalls, and mountain villages. They are popular for hiking, camping, and outdoor activities.

name: Yerevan City
description: Armenia’s capital is one of the world’s oldest continuously inhabited cities. It is known for pink volcanic stone architecture, museums, parks, cafes, and views of Mount Ararat.

name: Republic Square
description: Republic Square is the central landmark of Yerevan, surrounded by government buildings, museums, and fountains. Its distinctive Armenian stone architecture makes it a symbol of the capital.

name: Cascade Complex
description: The Cascade is a massive limestone staircase decorated with modern art installations and sculptures. From the top, visitors enjoy panoramic views of Yerevan and Mount Ararat.

name: Garni Temple
description: Garni Temple is the only surviving Greco-Roman colonnaded temple in Armenia. Built in the 1st century, it stands dramatically above the Azat River gorge.

name: Garni Gorge (Symphony of Stones)
description: The Garni Gorge is famous for its spectacular basalt columns resembling a natural organ. The dramatic canyon landscape is a popular hiking and photography destination.

name: Geghard Monastery
description: Geghard Monastery is carved partly into surrounding cliffs and represents medieval Armenian religious architecture. Its stone carvings, chapels, and mountain setting make it one of Armenia’s most important sites.

name: Mount Aragats
description: Mount Aragats is Armenia’s highest mountain and an extinct volcanic peak. It offers hiking routes, alpine scenery, and spectacular views across the Armenian highlands.

name: Byurakan Observatory
description: Located near Mount Aragats, Byurakan Observatory is one of Armenia’s leading astronomical centres. Visitors can explore Armenia’s contributions to astronomy and science.

name: Areni Wine Region
description: Areni is Armenia’s famous wine-producing area with ancient winemaking traditions. The region offers vineyards, wine tasting, caves, and beautiful valley landscapes.

name: Noravank Monastery
description: Noravank is a medieval monastery surrounded by red sandstone cliffs. Its unique architecture and dramatic canyon setting make it one of Armenia’s most photographed landmarks.

name: Jermuk Waterfall
description: Jermuk is a mountain resort famous for mineral springs and scenic landscapes. The waterfall and surrounding forests make it a popular relaxation destination.

name: Lake Sevan
description: Lake Sevan is one of the largest freshwater high-altitude lakes in the world. Its blue waters, beaches, and surrounding mountains make it Armenia’s top summer destination.

name: Sevanavank Monastery
description: Sevanavank sits on a peninsula overlooking Lake Sevan. The ancient monastery provides beautiful views of the lake and surrounding mountains.

name: Haghpat Monastery
description: Haghpat Monastery is a masterpiece of medieval Armenian architecture. Built between mountains and valleys, it represents Armenia’s religious and cultural heritage.

name: Sanahin Monastery
description: Sanahin Monastery was an important medieval centre of learning and theology. Its stone buildings and detailed carvings showcase traditional Armenian craftsmanship.

name: Dilijan National Park
description: Dilijan National Park is known as the “Armenian Switzerland” because of its forests, lakes, mountains, and peaceful landscapes. It is ideal for hiking and nature activities.

name: Haghartsin Monastery
description: Hidden inside Dilijan’s forests, Haghartsin Monastery features medieval churches surrounded by peaceful mountain scenery. It is one of Armenia’s most beautiful monastery complexes.

name: Gyumri Historic Centre
description: Gyumri is Armenia’s second-largest city, famous for traditional architecture, museums, crafts, and cultural festivals. Its old streets preserve Armenian urban heritage.

name: Mesrop Mashtots Monument
description: Oshakan is associated with Mesrop Mashtots, creator of the Armenian alphabet. The site is important for Armenian language and cultural identity.

name: Tatev Monastery
description: Tatev Monastery is a spectacular medieval complex built on the edge of a deep gorge. The nearby Wings of Tatev cable car provides one of the world’s most scenic rides.

name: Khndzoresk Caves
description: Khndzoresk is an ancient cave village with tunnels, cliffs, and suspension bridges. The unique landscape reflects centuries of human settlement in the Armenian mountains.

name: Sydney Opera House
description: The Sydney Opera House is Australia’s most iconic architectural landmark, famous for its unique sail-shaped design. It hosts world-class performances and offers spectacular views of Sydney Harbour.

name: Sydney Harbour Bridge
description: Known as the “Coathanger,” this famous bridge offers panoramic views of the harbour and city skyline. Visitors can walk across it or take the BridgeClimb experience.

name: Bondi Beach
description: Bondi Beach is one of Australia’s most famous beaches, known for golden sand, surfing culture, coastal walks, and vibrant seaside atmosphere.

name: Blue Mountains National Park
description: The Blue Mountains feature dramatic cliffs, eucalyptus forests, waterfalls, and deep valleys. Popular attractions include the Three Sisters rock formation and scenic hiking trails.

name: Port Stephens
description: Port Stephens is famous for beautiful beaches, dolphin cruises, sand dunes, and coastal landscapes. It is one of New South Wales’ top marine destinations.

name: Melbourne City
description: Melbourne is known for laneways, street art, museums, gardens, food culture, and sporting events. It is considered Australia’s cultural capital.

name: Twelve Apostles
description: The Twelve Apostles are dramatic limestone stacks rising from the Southern Ocean. They are one of Australia’s most photographed coastal landscapes.

name: Grampians National Park
description: The Grampians feature sandstone mountains, waterfalls, Aboriginal rock art, and diverse wildlife. It is a major destination for hiking and outdoor adventures.

name: Great Barrier Reef
description: The Great Barrier Reef is the world’s largest coral reef ecosystem, famous for colourful marine life, diving, snorkelling, and tropical islands.

name: Daintree Rainforest
description: The Daintree is one of the oldest rainforests on Earth, containing rare plants, wildlife, rivers, and mountains. It is one of the best places to experience Australia’s tropical wilderness.

name: Whitehaven Beach
description: Whitehaven Beach is famous for its pure white silica sand and crystal-clear turquoise water. It is considered one of the world’s most beautiful beaches.

name: Surfers Paradise
description: Surfers Paradise is a famous coastal destination known for skyscrapers, golden beaches, surfing, shopping, and nightlife.

name: K’gari National Park
description: K’gari is the world’s largest sand island, featuring rainforests, freshwater lakes, sand dunes, and unique wildlife. It is a major eco-tourism destination.

name: Uluru (Ayers Rock)
description: Uluru is Australia’s most famous natural landmark and a sacred site for Indigenous Australians. The massive red sandstone monolith changes colour dramatically throughout the day.

name: Kata Tjuta (The Olgas)
description: Kata Tjuta consists of 36 giant sandstone domes rising from the desert landscape. Hiking trails provide spectacular views and cultural experiences.

name: Kakadu National Park
description: Kakadu is Australia’s largest national park, featuring wetlands, waterfalls, wildlife, and thousands of years of Aboriginal cultural heritage.

name: Rottnest Island
description: Rottnest Island is famous for pristine beaches, cycling trails, and quokkas, friendly native marsupials found only in Western Australia.

name: Lucky Bay
description: Lucky Bay is known for its incredibly white sand, turquoise water, and kangaroos resting on the beach. It is one of Australia’s most scenic coastal locations.

name: Bungle Bungle Range
description: The Bungle Bungle Range features unique orange-and-black striped sandstone domes. Located in Purnululu National Park, it is one of Australia’s most spectacular geological wonders.

name: Port Arthur Historic Site
description: Port Arthur is a preserved former convict settlement that tells the story of Australia’s colonial history. It contains historic buildings, ruins, and museums.

name: Cradle Mountain-Lake St Clair National Park
description: This wilderness area features alpine mountains, ancient forests, and beautiful lakes. It is one of Australia’s premier hiking destinations.

name: Kangaroo Island
description: Kangaroo Island offers dramatic coastlines, beaches, forests, and abundant wildlife including kangaroos, seals, and koalas.

name: Wilpena Pound
description: Wilpena Pound is a massive natural amphitheatre surrounded by ancient mountains. It offers hiking, scenic flights, and views of Australia’s outback landscape.

name: Australian War Memorial
description: The Australian War Memorial combines museum galleries, memorial spaces, and historical collections documenting Australia’s military history.

name: Parliament House
description: Australia’s Parliament House is an impressive modern architectural landmark built into Capital Hill. Visitors can explore its public areas and exhibitions.

name: Schönbrunn Palace
description: Schönbrunn Palace is Austria’s most famous imperial residence and former summer home of the Habsburg rulers. Its grand rooms, gardens, fountains, and Gloriette viewpoint make it one of Europe’s finest cultural attractions.

name: Historic Centre of Vienna
description: Vienna’s historic centre features imperial palaces, Gothic churches, museums, and elegant streets shaped by centuries of European history. It is a major destination for art, music, and architecture lovers.

name: St. Stephen’s Cathedral
description: St. Stephen’s Cathedral is Vienna’s most recognisable landmark, known for its colourful tiled roof, Gothic towers, and historic interiors. Visitors can climb the tower for city views.

name: Belvedere Palace
description: The Belvedere is a magnificent Baroque palace complex housing important Austrian artworks, including Gustav Klimt’s famous painting “The Kiss.” Its gardens provide beautiful city views.

name: Prater Park & Giant Ferris Wheel
description: Vienna’s Prater is a historic amusement park famous for its giant Ferris wheel. It combines recreation, green spaces, and panoramic views of the city.

name: Historic Centre of Salzburg
description: Salzburg is the birthplace of Mozart and one of Europe’s most beautiful historic cities. Its baroque buildings, churches, and Alpine surroundings attract millions of visitors.

name: Hohensalzburg Fortress
description: Built on a hill above Salzburg, this medieval fortress is one of Europe’s best-preserved castles. It offers spectacular views of the city and surrounding Alps.

name: Mirabell Palace and Gardens
description: Mirabell Gardens are famous for their geometric flower beds, fountains, statues, and views toward Hohensalzburg Fortress. The palace is an important Baroque landmark.

name: Innsbruck Old Town
description: Innsbruck’s old town combines medieval streets, colourful buildings, and mountain scenery. It is one of Austria’s best destinations for culture and outdoor activities.

name: Nordkette Mountain Range
description: Nordkette rises directly above Innsbruck and offers hiking, skiing, and breathtaking views of the Alps. The cable car provides quick access to high mountain landscapes.

name: Hallstatt Village
description: Hallstatt is a picturesque lakeside village surrounded by mountains and known for its traditional houses, salt history, and stunning scenery. It is one of Austria’s most photographed places.

name: Lake Wolfgang (Wolfgangsee)
description: Lake Wolfgang is a beautiful Alpine lake surrounded by villages, forests, and mountains. It is popular for boating, hiking, and scenic relaxation.

name: Dachstein Ice Cave
description: Located in the Dachstein mountains, this ice cave features frozen formations, tunnels, and spectacular underground landscapes. It is one of Austria’s most unique natural attractions.

name: Graz Historic Centre
description: Graz combines medieval architecture with modern cultural attractions. Its old town, museums, and famous Schlossberg hill make it Austria’s second-largest cultural centre.

name: Schlossberg Hill
description: Schlossberg is a hill in the centre of Graz featuring a historic clock tower, gardens, and panoramic views over the city.

name: Grossglockner High Alpine Road
description: This spectacular mountain road crosses the Austrian Alps with views of glaciers, valleys, and Austria’s highest peak, Grossglockner. It is one of Europe’s most scenic drives.

name: Hohe Tauern National Park
description: Hohe Tauern National Park is Austria's largest national park, protecting glaciers, alpine meadows, and high peaks in the Central Eastern Alps.

name: Baku Old City (Icherisheher)
description: Icherisheher is the ancient heart of Baku, surrounded by historic walls and filled with medieval streets, mosques, palaces, and traditional buildings. It represents Azerbaijan’s rich cultural heritage.

name: Maiden Tower
description: The Maiden Tower is one of Azerbaijan’s most iconic landmarks, dating back centuries with mysterious origins. Its rooftop offers panoramic views of Baku and the Caspian Sea.

name: Palace of the Shirvanshahs
description: This 15th-century royal complex was the residence of the Shirvanshah rulers. It includes a palace, mosque, tombs, and architectural details reflecting medieval Azerbaijani culture.

name: Flame Towers
description: The Flame Towers are Baku’s most recognisable modern structures, inspired by Azerbaijan’s ancient fire symbolism. Their illuminated displays dominate the city skyline at night.

name: Heydar Aliyev Centre
description: Designed by architect Zaha Hadid, the Heydar Aliyev Centre is famous for its flowing curved design. It hosts exhibitions, cultural events, and art displays.

name: Yanar Dag (Burning Mountain)
description: Yanar Dag is a natural gas fire that has burned continuously on a hillside for decades. It reflects Azerbaijan’s historic connection with fire and is known as the “Land of Fire.”

name: Ateshgah Fire Temple
description: Ateshgah is an ancient fire temple associated with Zoroastrian and Hindu traditions. The restored complex provides insight into Azerbaijan’s historical religious connections.

name: Gobustan Rock Art Cultural Landscape
description: Gobustan contains thousands of ancient rock carvings showing prehistoric human life, hunting scenes, and rituals. The area also features unique mud volcano landscapes.

name: Gobustan Mud Volcanoes
description: Azerbaijan has one of the world’s highest concentrations of mud volcanoes. These unusual formations create a strange and fascinating landscape near the Caspian coast.

name: Mardakan Castle
description: Mardakan Castle is a medieval defensive structure built during the Shirvanshah period. Its towers and walls reflect Azerbaijan’s historic military architecture.

name: Qechresh Forest
description: Qechresh Forest is a scenic woodland area near Quba known for rivers, fresh air, and mountain landscapes. It is popular for picnics and nature escapes.

name: Khinaliq Village
description: Khinaliq is one of the highest and most remote villages in the Caucasus. It is famous for traditional stone houses, unique culture, and dramatic mountain scenery.

name: Shahdag National Park
description: Shahdag National Park protects alpine ecosystems, forests, and wildlife habitats. It offers hiking, mountain activities, and spectacular views of the Greater Caucasus.

name: Shahdag Mountain Resort
description: Shahdag is Azerbaijan’s premier mountain resort offering skiing, cable cars, hiking, and adventure activities. The surrounding Caucasus scenery attracts visitors throughout the year.

name: Tufandag Mountain Resort
description: Tufandag provides year-round mountain recreation with skiing in winter and hiking during summer. Cable cars offer views over forests and valleys.

name: Nohur Lake
description: Nohur Lake is surrounded by forests and mountains, creating a peaceful natural setting. It is popular for boating, photography, and relaxation.

name: Historic Centre of Sheki
description: Sheki is famous for traditional architecture, silk heritage, and mountain scenery. Its historic buildings reflect the importance of the Silk Road in Azerbaijan.

name: Palace of Sheki Khans
description: This 18th-century palace is famous for colourful stained glass windows, detailed paintings, and traditional Azerbaijani craftsmanship. It is one of the country’s finest architectural treasures.

name: Yeddi Gumbaz Mausoleum
description: The Yeddi Gumbaz Mausoleum is a historic burial complex connected with the Shirvan region. It showcases traditional Islamic architecture and stone craftsmanship.

name: Hirkan National Park
description: Hirkan National Park protects ancient subtropical forests with rare plant and animal species. It is one of Azerbaijan’s most important biodiversity areas.

name: Caspian Sea Coast
description: Azerbaijan’s Caspian coastline offers beaches, resorts, and seaside recreation. Popular coastal areas provide opportunities for swimming and relaxation.

name: Alinja Castle
description: Alinja Castle sits dramatically on a mountain peak and is often compared to the “Machu Picchu of Azerbaijan.” Its ruins provide stunning views over the surrounding landscape.

name: Duzdag Salt Cave
description: Duzdag Salt Cave is famous for salt therapy and underground chambers. It combines natural formations with wellness tourism experiences.
